Sprite texture edge for coronas and nebula gas.

GAS_PX

Gas sprite canvas edge in pixels.

rgb

Unpacks a packed hex color into [r, g, b] channel floats (0–255) — the canvas API wants css-rgba() strings, not three hex ints.

  • @param hex Packed color int (may be undefined → neutral grey fallback
  • @returns Channel triple.

css

rgba() css string for a channel triple + alpha.

  • @param c Channel triple.
  • @param a Alpha 0–1.

shade

Scales a channel triple toward white (k > 0) or black (k < 0) — crater rims, band highlights and corona streamers all derive from the body's own palette instead of carrying their own literals.

  • @param c Base channel triple.
  • @param k Shift −1..1.
  • @returns Shifted triple.

texCanvas

Creates a canvas + 2d context for texture generation, or null when the environment has no 2d (headless probes, blocked canvas) — every caller keeps its previous fallback in that case.

  • @param w Canvas width px.
  • @param h Canvas height px.

blob

Soft radial blob fill — the shared paint primitive: mottle patches, craters, gas lobes and flare knots are all radial gradients punched into the canvas at a point.

  • @param ctx 2d context.
  • @param x Center x.
  • @param y Center y.
  • @param r Blob radius px.
  • @param inner Inner-stop css color.
  • @param outer Outer-stop css color (usually alpha 0).

vnoise

Cheap value-noise 3d for vertex displacement — a three-octave hash of detuned sines (fundamental 0.55 + octave 0.3 + octave 0.15, wavenumber ratios ~2.7 and ~4.4) approximating band-limited fbm without a real gradient-noise import. Output stays in ≈[-1,1]; callers scale by their crumple amplitude so rock/moon silhouettes dimple deterministically.

  • @param x Sample x. @param y Sample y. @param z Sample z.
  • @returns Signed noise value ≈[-1,1].

weldGeometry

Welds a subdivided primitive's duplicated vertices into an INDEXED geometry — IcosahedronGeometry/TetrahedronGeometry emit every face's corners as independent vertices, so computeVertexNormals on the raw mesh produces PER-FACE normals: each triangle shades flat, which is exactly the crystalline "warty" facet look asteroids must not have. Welded vertices share one normal, so the displaced surface shades smooth (bumpy but continuous, like real rubble) — and vertex count drops ~85% (a detail-6 icosahedron's 246k verts become ~41k), cutting VRAM the same amount.

Vertex identity keys on the rounded position — subdivision vertices are bit-identical across faces, so a fixed-precision string dedups them deterministically. Callers displace the WELDED positions (one vertex = one noise evaluation) and bake UVs/normals afterwards.

  • @param THREE The three.js module.
  • @param geo Subdivided source geometry with a position attribute.
  • @returns Indexed geometry with a single welded position attribute.

byPos

Position → welded vertex index; 5 decimals ≈ sub-micron at unit scale.
